producer_report.summary: I created docs/design/study-capability-m1.md, a design-only document for the studying capability for firstmate M1. It covers the goal, the five-step method (pin, read, run, model, publish), the evidence rules, and the data model. It also covers the work-handling model with its validation rules, four alternatives tables with tradeoffs, reversal cost, out of scope, and a review gate. The review gate says nothing is built until an independent review is done, and lists eight things that review must check. It follows the athena-v0.md style and cites BRIEF.md line numbers. It makes no claims about firstmate; the only example system, "Example Runner", is labeled synthetic. I changed no other file.

checks_run.command: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings; cargo test --locked
checks_run.note: Not run. Only a Markdown file was added, so no Rust code changed.

open_issues: The brief's expected deliverables list docs/architecture.md, CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md as modify. Acceptance criterion 6 and the accepted assumptions say no other file changes. I followed the criterion and the assumptions and left those three files untouched. If you want CHANGELOG.md or docs/decisions.md updated, that needs a follow-up decision.
The four alternatives tables mark the proposed choice as 'chosen for review'. The author has not decided them, and the independent review is meant to challenge them.
The reversal-cost ratings in §7 are the author's estimates, not measurements, and the document says so.
mistakes: I had a typo ('a invented system') and fixed it. I did not re-read the whole document after writing it.
I did not read CHANGELOG.md or the rest of docs/decisions.md, because I chose not to modify them.
learnings: BRIEF.md S4 (line 306) defines M1 as work handling modeled formally as data. S5 (lines 320-321) defines the evidence and rationale-card rules. Line 277 says reusable material lives in the capability and system-specific material stays with the instance.
athena-v0.md uses a Status header and Contents list, numbered sections, and decision entries in the docs/decisions.md shape: Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Provenance.
desires: A clear ruling on whether the deliverables list or the acceptance criteria take precedence when they conflict.
The rest of athena-v0.md (lines 780 onward) was not read. I read only the first 780 lines for style.
